name: What is the difference between a full gut remodel and a cosmetic renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a full gut remodel and a cosmetic renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full gut renovation removes everything down to the wall studs and subfloor, allowing you to reconfigure floor plans, replace insulation, and update rough plumbing and wiring. A cosmetic remodel preserves the existing layout and focuses strictly on surface upgrades like painting, installing new trim or molding, swapping vanities, and replacing tile. Choosing a cosmetic update saves time and money, but if your home has outdated wiring, hidden moisture damage, or a layout that no longer functions, a complete teardown offers long-term durability and structural flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full gut removes finishes down to the framing to alter layouts and mechanicals, whereas a cosmetic remodel only updates surface finishes like paint, tile, and trim.
